# Wuji Hand2 Beta1 vendor notice

This bundle is imported from `release/v2026.7.23` at `2b57d2621caed4e65207bb767ba25fc8eaec0881`.

The Beta1 fingertip soft-pad STL files are retained as visual asset payloads but are not silently promoted into the formal collision set; the default MJCF uses the official convex-hull collision geoms.

This target-hand integration is a generic contract registration and does not claim reproduction of the original Wuji Hand hardware.
